Container.Name: lian-li-linux
Container.Overview:
Lian Li Linux: open-source replacement for L-Connect 3. Fan curves, RGB/LED effects, LCD streaming and sensor gauges for Lian Li fans, AIOs, Strimers and wireless dongles. Runs the hardware daemon, a phone-friendly dashboard with Unraid stats on your LCD fans, schedules and alerts, plus the full desktop GUI in the browser through noVNC.
Privileged mode is required for USB/HID access and hwmon temperature sensors. Run only one copy: the daemon must be the sole owner of the Lian Li hardware.
Not affiliated with Lian Li Industrial Co., Ltd.
Container.Requires: Lian Li USB devices (controller, AIO, LCD, or TX/RX dongles) connected to the Unraid server.

Config.Name: Dashboard port
Config.Description: Phone-friendly web dashboard: status, fans, lighting, LCD screens, schedules and alerts.

Config.Name: Full app port
Config.Description: noVNC web interface for the full Lian Li Linux GUI. If you change this, set Full app link port to the same number.

Config.Name: Unraid state
Config.Description: Unraid's array status files, used for drive temperatures, array usage and parity state. Read without waking sleeping drives.

Config.Name: AppData
Config.Description: Daemon configuration, fan curves, profiles, templates and managed LCD assets.

Config.Name: LCD media
Config.Description: Images, videos and fonts to pick from in the GUI for LCD screens. Browse to /media/lianli in the file dialog.

Config.Name: Dashboard password
Config.Description: Optional password for the dashboard (any username). Leave empty for none (only on a trusted LAN).

Config.Name: VNC password
Config.Description: Optional password for the full app. Leave empty for none (only on a trusted LAN).

Config.Name: Full app link port
Config.Description: Host port of the full app, used for the link in the dashboard. Keep it the same as Full app port.

Config.Name: Log level
Config.Description: Daemon log level: error, warn, info, debug, trace.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: UID the daemon and GUI run as (owner of AppData).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: GID the daemon and GUI run as.
